method: Fixed-center pooled source out-of-fold residual intervals (requested CV+ approximation)
formula: q = score_(ceil(0.90*(n+1))); interval = frozen target prediction + stored N0 offset if applicable +/- q
reason: Standard CV+ aggregates fold-specific target predictions +/- paired residuals; frozen full-source centers omit that variation.
guarantee: CV+ theory requires exchangeability and further fold assumptions; it does not transfer automatically across fields/years. This fixed-center approximation has no standard CV+ finite-sample guarantee even in source domain.
N0: Use source N-only OOF residuals unchanged; use the already stored target three-N0 shift for the target center; no target holdout labels used in construction.
uncertainty: 27 ordered resamples of three target blocks, conditional on frozen intervals; descriptive pointwise 95% percentile limits, not reliable new-domain uncertainty.
